notes.title: Update 9
notes.content: [h1]Update 9[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/1eafe3efac08630a9fe6384ce2be3a8fda43ce2b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]1. Life 'setback' weekend event cards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]basically multi turn nerf cards.[/p][/*][*][p]can be removed by doing certain task. [/p][/*][*][p]on succesful removal, there is a chance it will flip to life 'success' buff multi week card.[/p][/*][*][p]you can also remove setback card by playing mini game - [b]dice roll[/b] at temple building, but you won't get any card buffs you would normally get at card's fix task completion[/p][/*][*][p]failure to do card's task can result in spawning life regression card[/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/50a18f7902ffb3c3fbdb7b88d4ecd2ba59a1e28b.jpg"][/img][/h3][h3][b]2. Popularity & Person Of The Month event[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]every month (4 weeks/turns) most popular player gets a random bonus [b]POTM[/b] card with very nice mont-lasting bonuses. [/p][/*][*][p]popularity is achieved by working/learning/cards/buying certain items (like tickets or gym, or new like blood donation at hospital). [/p][/*][*][p]each job has different popularity work bonus e.g. CEO is 0, while university teacher have big bonus. [/p][/*][*][p]earning [b]POTM [/b]card 3 times in row spawns [b]Person of the Season[/b] card, which is more buffed version of [b]POTM card.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/4ec0b850994b84df707f23b8d83577cf26782ed6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]3. Detailed game stats, [/b][/h3][list][*][p]available during game and end game screen. Probably not useful but looks cool.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/6ff9799403252014fb03b3c98b939566c321661e.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]4. University courses.[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Takes some money and time (3-4 steps) to complete[/p][/*][*][p]provides passive buffs for a player. [/p][/*][*][p]All bonuses nicely visible in stats.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/d1333eca24f1382775d4c90ac40d7b8175a07e0e.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]5. Motor vehicles uses fuel[/b][/h3][list][*][p]you can refill at market. [/p][/*][*][p]if you go out of gas, player auto switches to walking mode.[/p][/*][*][p]vehicles slightly faster (less time wasted driving around map)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]6. More strategic Evil items.[/b][/h3][list][*][p]evil items now goes out of stock for few (3-5) weeks after use (cooldown)[/p][/*][*][p]much greater (~~90%) chance that the item will work when buying. [/p][/*][*][p]new evil items targeting cash at hand and university:[/p][list][*][p]Tax all players (cash lost 10-40%)[/p][/*][*][p]Release rats at university (building not available for 1-2 weeks)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/067a1e2b2f6c65a9c984732cf759afb8d5f2d94e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]7. Slot "fruit" machine mini game at ticket building.[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Costs time and stress so useful if you really short on cash, or feeling LUCKY[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]8. Stock market updates.[/b][/h3][list][*][p]more realistic with implemented violatility, supply, demand,[/p][/*][*][p]season events[/p][/*][*][p]new stock related events that shows up in newspaper.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/494c08ee3ac6bd5a5c0e6d86a01d682ab137f957.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]9. Minor things[/b][/h3][list][*][p]pawned items are turn bombed - they dissapear from pawn store after 2-5 weeks[/p][/*][*][p]job indicator in jobs building showing there is better paid job[/p][/*][*][p]clock icon shows correct item/card time consumption, not static vague image[/p][/*][*][p]save game slot shows how many (human) players are playing this game[/p][/*][*][p]multiplayer turn time limit option[/p][/*][*][p]onscreen icons for your house, job, players and mouse hover/pad select at any building. can be disabled in options \[v] Icons[/p][/*][*][p]stress affects education time[/p][/*][*][p]detailed perk stats when hovering over university degree (brainwave event is hidden)[/p][/*][*][p]Fast Pass monthly item in market to go thru road blockade[/p][/*][*][p]smoooother player pawn walk animation[/p][/*][*][p]too much learning nerf card similiar to overworking[/p][/*][*][p]+40 new weekend events[/p][/*][*][p]sell all stocks button[/p][/*][*][p]if you own a newspaper, it will show up also on bank's broker screen[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/efea3f59874dbbdc2d77940352ced37ba378e931.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/1a2c13a1fd36afe98a0db10a752c98f1e3766a10.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]10.Fixes & tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]press and hold on work/relax/education buttons[/p][/*][*][p]items diplay icon if they are turn limited[/p][/*][*][p]weekend events less repeatable[/p][/*][*][p]thief attack chance doesn't decrease if you visit any building, only 3 decrease the chance (bank. market, low rent)[/p][/*][*][p]brainwave event tweak to -25% from -50% education time[/p][/*][*][p]redeem item in pawn shop had wrong price[/p][/*][*][p]NPC going funky on certain building closing and opening building screen without doing anything[/p][/*][*][p]NPC stuck on mass relaxing when can't work and low on cash[/p][/*][*][p]NPC logic updated[/p][/*][*][p]rain less annoying visually[/p][/*][*][p]item images less aliased when displayed as small icons[/p][/*][*][p]ui performance[/p][/*][*][p]main turn clock updates to look nicer[/p][/*][*][p]exit button anim fixes[/p][/*][*][p]less likely to get luxury items when working as ceo of wallmall[/p][/*][*][p]wrong boat player position on venice map after map load (ooops!)[/p][/*][*][p]newspaper stuck on fast player switch[/p][/*][*][p]job xp/dependibility tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]food, hats, tickets and pray items excluded from end screen stats 'items bought'[/p][/*][*][p]money & happiness game score target bumped up[/p][/*][*][p]multiplayer bugs (x10) fixes and rewritten multiplayer code for stability and performance. might broke something xd[/p][/*][*][p]steam multiplayer broken?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi! ːsteamhappyː[/b][/h2]
[olist]
[*] [h2]New map[/h2]
New Tokio night map with new work place, events and items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/8239db97c48d93e6fd02b444f6a882d905f69d5c.jpg[/img]

[*][h2]New job specific perks[/h2]
Over 30 job specific events may show up on weekends. Free education tier for university workers, tips for restaurant jobs, item bonuses for Mall, free newspaper for Market folks. And maybe winter holiday gifts for all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/ef604c1eac7e2529a0363f01c1ac06dbbda4b8ff.jpg[/img]

[*][h3]Changed weekend events mechanics[/h3]
Now there are xx bad, xx neutral, xx good and xx special cards to pick. Number of these is also luck dependand. So with a bit of luck you can get good or bad weekend. 
Previously cards you get were all random with luck influence.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/6f954cfc4cf85f7fa7f8a0a7cdc8a440e5e1c9a2.jpg[/img]

[*][h3]Changed mood/stress mechanics[/h3]
Now everything you do or buy, including weekend cards, infulences strees/mood more and effects scale up as game progress. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/daf7585978852f17853aa63e44ae398624783c69.jpg[/img]


[*][h3] New stuff including computer player level, animations and quality improvements[/h3]
- over 30 new animations
- 40 new weekend cards
- various graphics changes and improvements
- overall game balance
- performance improvement to match all maps to 30fps on 10 years old laptop (1050 mobile - medium quality/disabled sun animation)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/8689d8c721003ff2669519a38d58461211bedeaa.jpg[/img]

[*] (Unofficial) (multi) Gamepad support/improvements and bug fixes

- navigation using bumper keys everywhere it's possible, including map traversing, items in buildings, top menus etc
- player icon helper on map
- virtual keyboard to change name on game start
- bug fixes and bug fixes :( 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914267/4a9edad30041c27ad8a0dfa7580bd78543a762d1.jpg[/img]

[*] [i]Changed 'Elon' computer player name to something less obnoxious.[/i]

[/olist]
[h1]Have fun![/h1]
